normalizedOutcome: A new Markdown execution plan turns the six confirmed workflow diagnoses into five ordered, implementation-ready workstreams with acceptance criteria and regression safeguards.
acceptanceClaim: The new decision document exists and contains the evidence table, five cohesive workstreams, dependency order, verification matrix, risk controls, rollback, and explicit non-goals.
